parameters.name: AppId
parameters.description: The application ID. You can view your application IDs by navigating to **ApsaraVideo Live > Live+ > ApsaraVideo Real-time Communication > Application Management**. If no application exists, create one by clicking **Create Application**.

parameters.name: ChannelId
parameters.description: The ID of the channel to join.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The idempotency parameter.
> This parameter is used to identify whether multiple requests are the same request. We recommend that you do not specify this parameter for this operation.

parameters.name: DisplayName
parameters.description:
The display name of the user in the channel.
> Chinese characters and other characters are supported. To avoid excessively long names, keep the size under 32 bytes.

parameters.name: ExpireTime
parameters.description:
The validity period of the ingest URL. Unit: seconds. Default value: 43200.
> If the validity period expires, an ongoing stream that uses the URL generated by this operation is not affected. However, a new stream ingest attempt using the same URL will fail.

parameters.name: UserId
parameters.description: The user ID. The user ID must be unique within the channel.
